app.name: NyayaLens
app.tagline: Understand what you sign, with proof
app.demoExplain: Answers come from a built-in offline provider, not from a language model. Every quote is still checked against your document.
app.disclaimer: NyayaLens explains documents. It isn't legal advice.
app.howItWorks: How it works and its limits

upload.heading: Check a document before you sign it
upload.intro: Upload or paste a rental agreement, job offer, loan agreement, policy or notice. NyayaLens explains it in plain language and shows you the exact clause behind every statement.
upload.dropHere: Drop a PDF, Word file or text file here
upload.pasteHint: Paste the whole document. Nothing is stored.
upload.sampleHint: Four fictional documents, so you can see how it works without uploading anything.
upload.privacyBody: Aadhaar and PAN numbers, phone numbers and email addresses are hidden before anything is sent for analysis. Nothing is stored: close the tab and it is gone.
upload.privacyDemo: In demo mode nothing leaves this server at all.
upload.roleHint: Risk severity is judged from your side of the document.

laws.heading: Old and new criminal laws
laws.intro: The Indian Penal Code, the Code of Criminal Procedure and the Indian Evidence Act were replaced on 1 July 2024. Look up an old section to see what it corresponds to in the new codes.
laws.examples: Try: IPC 420 · 498A IPC · S. 65B Evidence Act · CrPC 438
laws.whenAppliesText: The new codes came into force on 1 July 2024. Conduct before that date is still charged, tried and appealed under the old codes, and cases already pending may continue under the old procedure. Ask a lawyer which applies to your situation.
laws.noEquivalent: No direct equivalent in the new code
laws.notStored: The full text of this section is not stored in NyayaLens. Read it on India Code.
laws.notFound: No mapping found for that section.
laws.unreviewedNote: This row was extracted automatically and has not yet been checked against the source by a person.
laws.sourceNote: From the correspondence tables published by the Bureau of Police Research & Development, 21 June 2024. They are a police training aid and reference document, not a statutory instrument.
laws.referenceOnly: This is a reference. NyayaLens does not say which section applies to your situation, and cannot predict what a court would do.

about.heading: How it works, and its limits
about.pipeline: How a statement gets on the screen
about.pipelineBody: The model is asked to quote the clause behind every statement it makes. Code then searches for that quote in the clause it names. A statement whose quote cannot be found is removed before you see it, and the removal is reported. That is why an answer can say 'this document doesn't say': it is a result, not a failure.
about.dataSources: Where the law data comes from
about.willAndWont: What NyayaLens will and won't do
about.willDo: It explains what your document says, shows you where, flags what is missing, and helps you prepare for a professional.
about.wontDo: It will not tell you whether to sign, predict what a court would do, or tell you what the law requires of you.
about.whenLawyerBody: If money you cannot afford to lose is at stake, if you have received a notice with a deadline, or if anything here surprised you, speak to a lawyer. Free legal aid is available to people who qualify.
about.whyNotGeneral: Why not a general AI assistant?

whyNot.citations: Verified citations. Quotes are matched against your document by code, not trusted from the model. A statement that cannot be matched is removed before you see it, and the removal is reported.
whyNot.failClosed: Fail-closed answers. “This document doesn’t say” is a first-class result, never a guess.
whyNot.deterministic: Checks a model cannot fake. Amount-in-words against digits, clause-level version diffs, defined-term extraction and old-law detection are ordinary code.
whyNot.officialData: Official data, not model memory. Old-to-new law mappings come from the published correspondence tables and provision texts from India Code, with the source shown on every row.
whyNot.workflows: Guided, role-aware workflows. Document-type checklists, what-if scenarios and comparison tables, instead of an empty chat box.
whyNot.lockedFacts: Actionable outputs with locked facts. Letters and briefs download as Word and PDF. Every fact comes from your confirmed facts sheet; the model never types a number, date or name.
whyNot.privacy: Privacy by design. Aadhaar and PAN numbers, phone numbers and email addresses are masked before any model call, and nothing is stored.
whyNot.accessible: Accessible and multilingual. WCAG 2.2 AA, explanations in English, Hindi and Marathi, and tagged PDFs.
